main.name: Sara
main.title: AI Engineer
main.tagline: I build AI agents and the tools they need to do real work.
bio: I'm an AI engineer with more than four years in software. I build agents and everything around them: the harness, the evals, and the infrastructure they run on. I spent over three years at BBVA, where systems can't go down, and in my last year there I built internal agents that made my team faster.
Now I work remotely at Valere and build open-source tools for agents, like ccdesk. Linux and open source are where I feel at home.
